title: Search Provider Secret Policy
description: Policy for handling API keys and secrets for external search providers. Keys MUST only come from environment variables, never from files. Ledgers MUST NOT record raw keys.

secretSource.description: Secrets MUST come from environment variables only

keyEnvVarNames.description: Accepted env var names, e.g. ZHIPUAI_API_KEY, GLM_API_KEY

forbiddenStorage.description: Locations where keys must NEVER appear

recordSecretPresence.description: Only record true/false, never the key value

missingKeyBehavior.description: What to do when env var is not set

scanOutputsOnWrite.description: Scan outputs for key-like patterns before write

blockedPatterns.description: Regex patterns that indicate possible key leaks

rotationPolicy.description: Key rotation is manual for now; no auto-rotation
